metadata.scenario: A caller inquires about the cost of a package of wellness sessions for corporate clients and asks for a quote. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Lucille Davis. I hope you’re doing well! Hi Lucille! I'm doing well, thank you. How can I assist you today? I wanted to inquire about the cost of a package of wellness sessions for corporate clients. Absolutely! Are you looking for a specific type of wellness session? Yes, I’m thinking about incorporating some health and wellness programs for my former colleagues. That sounds like a great idea! We offer various services like physical therapy, wellness checks, and health education. Right, what would be the cost for those sessions? For corporate wellness sessions, we generally recommend a bundle of physical therapy and health education. And what do those packages generally run? Our physical therapy sessions range from $110 to $140 each, and we can offer a discount if you book multiple sessions together. That sounds good. What kind of discount are you talking about? If you book a package of ten sessions, we can offer each session at $100. Would that be something you’re interested in? Yes, that sounds reasonable. Great! I can prepare a formal quote for you. Would you like it sent via email? Yes, please. My email is lucille.davis@email.com. Got it, Lucille. I’ll send that over shortly. Thank you! Anything else I should know? Just to mention, we could also provide wellness workshops if you're interested in a more comprehensive approach. Workshops sound interesting. Could you provide more details in the email? Absolutely, I'll include information about our workshops in the quote email. Great! I appreciate your help with this. No problem at all, Lucille! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? That’s all for now. Thank you again! You're welcome! Have a wonderful day, Lucille. You too, bye! Bye!
